content: भृत्य {%a.%} [भृ क्यप् तक् च] To be nourished or maintained <ab>&c.</ab> .{@-त्यः@} .²1 Any one requiring to be supported. .²2 A servant, dependant, slave. .²3 A kingʼs servant, minister of state; भृत्यप्रणाशो मरणं नृपाणाम् <ls>H. 2. 136</ls>. .²4 A subject. .{@-त्या@} .²1 Rearing, fostering, nourishing, taking care of; as in कुमारभृत्या <ab>q. v.</ab> .²2 Maintenance, support. .²3 A means of sustenance, food. .²4 Wages. .²5 Service.
